options.title: She Started Spanx With {fact1}
options.first_line: Sara Blakely started Spanx with {fact1} she had saved selling fax machines.
options.first_frame: Sara Blakely's photo with her name, cutting on 'fax' to an office fax machine.

options.title: Sara Blakely Built Spanx From Cut-Up Pantyhose
options.first_line: Sara Blakely built Spanx from one pair of pantyhose with the feet cut off.
options.first_frame: A pair of pantyhose pushes in, a pair of scissors snaps across the feet, then Sara Blakely's photo.

options.title: A Fax Machine Seller Started Spanx. How?
options.first_line: Spanx was started by a woman who sold fax machines door to door.
options.first_frame: An office fax machine printing a page, cutting to the Spanx store sign in a mall.

why: It names Sara Blakely and Spanx and puts a small, concrete starting sum next to a brand everyone knows, so a stranger wants to know how that became Spanx; B gives away the pantyhose twist and C holds back who it is about.
